title: rand() Considered Harmful
summary: Stephan T. Lavavej's GoingNative 2013 talk explaining why calling rand() and using rand() % 100 is bad in C++, and how the C++11 <random> header does the job properly.
why: It is the standard reference for why rand() is broken in C++ and what to use instead.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: recommended by Stephan T. Lavavej, maintainer of Visual Studio's C++ Standard Library, in his "rand() Considered Harmful" talk
